stem: Which sentence best helps the reader understand that the story is told from the first-person point of view?

options.label: F
options.text: The stove was a giant Bunsen burner, and the pots and pans were beakers and flasks. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: Sarah came in from the living room. (paragraph 7)

options.label: H
options.text: Then she showed me what I needed to do. (paragraph 10)

options.label: J
options.text: Sarah wrapped the lid with one of the yellow rubber gloves by the sink, took a deep breath, and twisted. (paragraph 14)
